text:
Cheng: morning async check — gateway / routing / auth / rate-limits. What I did: finished the canary policy for route-mux and opened PR #3124. Blockers: seeing short 429 spikes in staging when token bursts happen (~3s windows). Today: want to pair with infra to adjust token-bucket and run a focused load test. Can someone eyeball the CR?
Maria: saw the PR, left a tiny comment about the default Retry-After header and noticed a metrics dip in region-eu this morning.
Alex: I can review in ~1h. For the staging 429s we saw long-polling tests trigger a burst — might need to cap max_concurrency on the ingress limiter. @Sam can you confirm logs?
Sam: on it — pulling logs now. FYI I bumped the limiter rate for the canary by 20% and reduced the burst window, rolling the change for 5m to observe.
Cheng: thanks. quick config snippet for reference:
Sam: ```
rate_limit:
  window_ms: 1000
  max_tokens: 1200
  burst: 200
```
Cheng: also curious re: auth JWT rotation — PR #3119 merged last week; any fallout?
Maria: no prod fallout, but discovered one internal service still using the old KID; filed ticket INF-982 to track.
Alex: review done, left :+1:.
deploy-bot: canary:gateway-config updated by Sam; change id cfg-2026-04-07-37; status: success.
Cheng: follow-ups: 1) @Alex please LGTM PR when you can. 2) @Maria can you drop INF-982 link here. 3) I'll draft a 1-paragraph playbook for post-429 triage.
Maria: INF-982: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-982
Alex: lgtm :thumbsup:
Sam: logs show 3 short bursts at 02:14 / 03:08 / 05:22 UTC — adding timestamps to the ticket.
Cheng: ok closing loop — will pair at 11:00am PT to push limiter tweak to staging and run load checks. If we still see issues we'll rollback the canary. Thanks all :pray:
